subject: My big shiny app runs very well locally in IE11, but very slow when deploying it to the shinyapps.io in IE11!!

messages.author: e20c8880efd84f8d
messages.subject: My big shiny app runs very well locally in IE11, but very slow when deploying it to the shinyapps.io in IE11!!
parts:
Hi! I have a big app running very well locally, but when I deploy it to shinyapps.io it runs very slowly in IE11. The page takes few seconds to load and there is a latency in render functions. This is not the same case in chrome. In chrome it works very well locally and when deploying it too. I want to make my app run better in IE11 when deploying it, how can I do that? what are the reasons behind the loading page latency in IE11?

Thank you for your support!
Best Regards,
Karni

messages.subject: Re: My big shiny app runs very well locally in IE11, but very slow when deploying it to the shinyapps.io in IE11!!
parts:
Without knowing what you mean by big, or what your application is doing, I would suggest posting to the Shiny Community to reach a broader audience of Shiny users.

If IE11 has a developer console in which you can view the network traffic of requests, you might see what is going slowly from the browser's perspective.
